rows.grounds: tatpuruṣa compound: sarasīruha (lotus) + homa (oblation), instrumental of means

items.question: What reward does a man gain through oblation performed with lotuses?
premises: An oblation is performed using lotuses.
A man performs this lotus oblation.
items.inference: Therefore, a man who performs a lotus oblation obtains sovereignty.
uncertainties: The verbal root of bhalate is uncertain; it is glossed as obtains based on context and legacy hint.
items.plain_english: By performing an oblation with lotuses, a man obtains sovereignty.
